# Vox Programming Language — Complete LLM / Agent Documentation Index
> Vox is a pre-1.0 (workspace 0.6.0) AI-native full-stack language that compiles to Rust and TypeScript.
> One .vox file can compile to a database schema, a type-safe server, and a browser UI.
> Install today by building from source. See https://voxlang.org/reference/stability/ for maturity.
> Current syntax: bare `table` / `query` / `mutation` / `server` / `tool` / `component`.
> Retired (do not emit): `@endpoint`, `@table type`, `@mcp.tool`.
> Not the unrelated Vox-lang (English-to-assembly) project.

## Agent Policy Entry Points
- [AGENTS.md](https://voxlang.org/AGENTS.md): Cross-tool policy for all coding agents (required reading)
- [GEMINI.md](https://voxlang.org/GEMINI.md): Antigravity-specific overlay for this repo
- [CLAUDE.md](https://voxlang.org/CLAUDE.md): Claude Code overlay

## Retired Surfaces (Do Not Use)
The following symbols are retired and must NOT be used in generated code:
- `vox-dei` → replaced by `vox-orchestrator`
- `vox-ars` → `vox-openclaw-runtime`
- `@component fn Name()` → replaced by `component Name() {}`
- `@endpoint(kind: …)` → `query` / `mutation` / `server` (bare keywords)
- `recall()` / `recall_async()` → `MemoryManager::lookup_fact_by_key`
- `TURSO_URL` / `VOX_TURSO_URL` → `VOX_DB_URL`

*(Hand-maintained companion to /llms.txt. Starlight also generates a site-root /llms.txt at build time.)*
